# Accessibility Checklist: Questionnaire Feedback

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature requirements fully specify keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, contrast, touch-target, and stepper accessibility for all questionnaire surfaces.
**Created**: 2026-06-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are reduced-motion requirements defined for all four named animations: smiley draw-in, check draw-in, progress fill, and muted skip? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK002 Are keyboard operability requirements defined for all confirmatory prompt answers despite the prompt being non-dismissable by misclick? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK003 Are screen-reader requirements defined for the sticky confirmatory prompt, including prompt purpose, available answers, and state changes? [Gap, Spec §FR-015-FR-017]
- [ ] CHK004 Are focus handling requirements defined for the confirmatory prompt so it is answerable without trapping focus or blocking the rest of the app? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK005 Are weekly stepper accessibility requirements defined for focus movement to the newly revealed question after Q1 selection? [Gap, Spec §FR-044-FR-046]
- [ ] CHK006 Are weekly progress bar announcement requirements defined so step/state changes are understandable to assistive technology? [Gap, Spec §FR-044]
- [ ] CHK007 Are Back and Done reachability requirements specified for keyboard and assistive-technology users in the weekly two-step flow? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044, Spec §FR-048]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "honor `prefers-reduced-motion`" clarified with expected reduced-motion end states rather than only naming the media preference? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Spec §SC-013]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "non-dismissable by misclick" defined narrowly enough to avoid conflicting with keyboard answerability and normal app accessibility? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK010 Are touch-target requirements quantified for every option, skip, Back, Done, and route action across all three instruments? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK011 Are light and dark contrast requirements traceable to WCAG AA and Graphite semantic roles for all questionnaire states? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are accessibility requirements consistent with the mock-bound visual states without allowing the mock to override repo Graphite tokens or Principle VI? [Consistency, Spec §Styling Source, Spec §FR-004-FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Are accessibility requirements consistent across confirmatory prompt, session-end card, and weekly card rather than applying only to the shared shell? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001-FR-010, Spec §User Story 4]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Are accessibility success criteria measurable for 360px viewport, 44px touch targets, WCAG AA in both themes, and reduced-motion completion? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011-SC-013]
- [ ] CHK015 Are acceptance criteria defined for keyboard and screen-reader operation of the non-dismissable confirmatory prompt and weekly stepper? [Gap, Spec §User Story 4]
